description: Human labels by Codex for Helmut (D), 2026-10-31, attachment order 1-14. Photos stay at absolute external paths, never in git. Team reports REWE; EDEKA Sued tags in #8-11/#13-14 conflict, so provenance remains unconfirmed. Prices are EUR base shelf prices, exclude Pfand. Gesture truth records visible counts (including invalid one-finger signs); expectedGesture is a hypothetical legal challenge, not recovered issuance except #3 UI. Null truth is unknown/absent, explained per label. OOS path used for intended empty Fuze spot (#1,#2,#12), O5 unknown because facing boundary is ambiguous. OBSERVED does not prove stock for tag-only closeups. Notes enumerate every applicable gate; unknown gates are not asserted by expect.failedGates. G6 uses synthetic request timing; G7 uses independent empty history (no duplicateOf). This is dry evaluation material, never payment/location/freshness evidence.
